1: #===============================================================================
2: # Move objects known by Pokémon.
3: #===============================================================================
4: class Pokemon
5:   class Move
6:     # This move's ID.
7:     attr_reader :id
8:     # The amount of PP remaining for this move.
9:     attr_reader :pp
10:     # The number of PP Ups used on this move (each one adds 20% to the total PP).
11:     attr_reader :ppup
12: 
13:     # Creates a new Move object.
14:     # @param move_id [Symbol, String, GameData::Move] move ID
15:     def initialize(move_id)
16:       @id   = GameData::Move.get(move_id).id
17:       @ppup = 0
18:       @pp   = total_pp
19:     end
20: 
21:     # Sets this move's ID, and caps the PP amount if it is now greater than this
22:     # move's total PP.
23:     # @param value [Symbol, String, GameData::Move] the new move ID
24:     def id=(value)
25:       @id = GameData::Move.get(value).id
26:       @pp = @pp.clamp(0, total_pp)
27:     end
28: 
29:     # Sets this move's PP, capping it at this move's total PP.
30:     # @param value [Integer] the new PP amount
31:     def pp=(value)
32:       @pp = value.clamp(0, total_pp)
33:     end
34: 
35:     # Sets this move's PP Up count, and caps the PP if necessary.
36:     # @param value [Integer] the new PP Up value
37:     def ppup=(value)
38:       @ppup = value
39:       @pp = @pp.clamp(0, total_pp)
40:     end
41: 
42:     # Returns the total PP of this move, taking PP Ups into account.
43:     # @return [Integer] total PP
44:     def total_pp
45:       max_pp = GameData::Move.get(@id).total_pp
46:       return max_pp + (max_pp * @ppup / 5)
47:     end
48:     alias totalpp total_pp
49: 
50:     def function_code;  return GameData::Move.get(@id).function_code; end
51:     def power;          return GameData::Move.get(@id).power;         end
52:     def type;           return GameData::Move.get(@id).type;          end
53:     def category;       return GameData::Move.get(@id).category;      end
54:     def physical_move?; return GameData::Move.get(@id).physical?;     end
55:     def special_move?;  return GameData::Move.get(@id).special?;      end
56:     def status_move?;   return GameData::Move.get(@id).status?;       end
57:     def accuracy;       return GameData::Move.get(@id).accuracy;      end
58:     def effect_chance;  return GameData::Move.get(@id).effect_chance; end
59:     def target;         return GameData::Move.get(@id).target;        end
60:     def priority;       return GameData::Move.get(@id).priority;      end
61:     def flags;          return GameData::Move.get(@id).flags;         end
62:     def name;           return GameData::Move.get(@id).name;          end
63:     def description;    return GameData::Move.get(@id).description;   end
64:     def hidden_move?;   return GameData::Move.get(@id).hidden_move?;  end
65: 
66:     # @deprecated This method is slated to be removed in v22.
67:     def base_damage
68:       Deprecation.warn_method("base_damage", "v22", "power")
69:       return @power
70:     end
71: 
72:     def display_type(pkmn);     return GameData::Move.get(@id).display_type(pkmn, self);     end
73:     def display_category(pkmn); return GameData::Move.get(@id).display_category(pkmn, self); end
74:     def display_damage(pkmn);   return GameData::Move.get(@id).display_damage(pkmn, self);   end
75:     def display_accuracy(pkmn); return GameData::Move.get(@id).display_accuracy(pkmn, self); end
76:   end
77: end
